messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm running a short workshop tomorrow 10am to finalize the competitive hooks for the launch posts and webinar. Goal is one tight benchmark narrative + 3 field-ready soundbites. Can people bring 1-2 suggested CTAs and 1 example inbound routing rule?

alex: I'll bring draft CTAs. leaning toward: 'Predictable inference, predictable cost' and 'Same API, any deployment'.

sam: For benchmarks: we should lead with 95th percentile latency vs. cloud-hosted endpoints on real prompt mixes, then call out cost/token improvements with batching + cache. Suggest a small table in the blog and a short GIF of request throughput.

jen: @sam +1. Also want a one-liner for sales: 'Ship LLM features without building an ops team'.

aaron: Routing idea: if company_size == enterprise AND compliance_req == true -> route to AE & solutions-eng; else if monthly_usage_tokens > 2e9 -> SDR+AE; otherwise -> self-serve trial funnel.

pat_k: +1 on routing. Add a micro-play for trials: automated checkbox that surfaces Dedicated/Private as a value prop during signup if they select "security/compliance".

nick_r: Webinar hook draft: 'How we cut inference cost 3x without breaking SLAs' — demo QPS, chart of latency percentiles, and a short customer quote. Keep it practical (ops + engineering focus).

maya: Love the webinar hook. For the benchmark narrative we must be careful: call out test harness, model family, prompt set size. Make sure legal + research signoff — we don't claim 'faster' without measured context.

alex: Quick CTA options for assets: 1) Try a 14-day Dedicated trial, 2) Run your workload against our benchmark harness (we'll run first 5k tokens), 3) Join the webinar. Which maps best to inbound routing?

sam: Map 1->AE, 2->SWE-led demo request (solutions-eng), 3->marketing nurture (webinar flow). Keep option 2 gated — needs usage sample + NDA for sensitive data.

jen: Messaging note: When comparing to cloud AI platforms, avoid direct pricing numbers. Focus on predictable costs and knobs (batching/quantization/rollouts) and the ops burden they hide.

aaron: For infra vendors angle: highlight unified runtime + fallbacks. Show a small flow: hosted -> dedicated -> private with same API. Two sentence customer story for each.

pat_k: Ops-bot just ran a check on doc templates and flagged the benchmark appendix as missing a test spec. ops-bot: please attach test harness README before publish. :robot_face:

maya: Action items before tomorrow: alex and sam - bring CTAs + benchmark outline; jen - draft 2 sales soundbites; aaron + pat_k - inbound routing matrix; nick_r - webinar draft slide deck (5 slides). I'll collate and run through at 10am. If anyone wants to pre-upload snippets, drop them in #marketing-assets.

nick_r: I'll put a 3-slide executive summary in the folder before the meeting.

alex: I'll include two CTA variants and a short A/B test plan for the landing page.

maya: Thanks — see you tomorrow. :thumbsup:
